# decision(hfp-024): choose the EU host for the API and Postgres

## Task

ADR 0001 says data is stored only in our own API and Postgres, hosted in the EU. Nothing is deployed yet; everything runs locally (Docker Postgres, `server/` on `127.0.0.1:3001`). Choose where the API and database will run.

Criteria to weigh: EU data residency and an EU-based company (no US parent, if that matters for the transfer assessment), a data processing agreement, managed Postgres 17 with backups and point-in-time restore, cost at small scale, and how the Hono server is deployed (container or Node).

## Parent Story

Hosted-first pivot (ADR 0001).

## Blocked by

Nothing. Doesn't block feature work, but must be done before any real user data is stored.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A short comparison of 2 to 4 candidates against the criteria above.
- [ ] The choice is recorded as an ADR, including the DPA, data location, backups and how deletion requests reach backups.
- [ ] Follow-up tasks (deploy pipeline, secrets, migrations in production) are added to `notes/task-list.md`.

## Suggested label

`ready-for-human` (decision)
